text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaaah-----!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Th-That was nuts... unreal...! Did you see 
that? The sheer spirit they showed before 
the finish line!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
“No way... That feisty biter Umamusume 
is...? Haha, hahahaha...”

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Who called her a joke character?! Isn't 
she actually amazing...?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The venue was in an uproar over the 
unexpectedly heated race. I instinctively 
pumped my fist in the air.

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
*pant*...! *gasp*...! *pant*...! 
*gasp*...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Windy-senpai, look. Look at the faces in 
the crowd...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Look, you're totally stunned!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, ugh... Uuuuughhhhh...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Ugaaaahhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: W-Windy-senpai... !?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: HELL YEAAAHHHH!!! RAAAAWWWWRRRRRRR!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Listen to that! Shinko Windy is roaring! 
This wild power must be the very source of 
her strength!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Way to go, Shinko Windy!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe... Looks like we managed to defeat 
the villain, Labelder.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Biko! We did it! Everyone finally, finally 
looked this way, nanodaaa~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Heheheh... ♪ It was well worth 
running all this way...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! That's the result of Windy-senpai 
pushing forward without giving up!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Alright, did it... That's it, this is the 
way. A hero can't just be strong after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I've gotta save someone and make them 
happy!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, mission accomplished! We 
successfully rescued Windy-senpai!
choice_data_list: Yeah! The race performance was great, too!
Yeah! It was a great race overall too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus can manage dirt well enough. 
She pulled through, even on this bad track 
condition.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
So Captain Onion, give me the next order! 
Where is the next person waiting for my 
help!?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh!? There's nobody~? Then I can't be a 
hero, that's so boring~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if told to do so, people who are 
troubled aren't just found that easily. 
Such times happen.
choice_data_list:
Maybe it's time to build up strength back 
in the short-distance races.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Build up our strength... That's right...! 
If an even bigger crisis occurs, we won't 
have the power to resolve it unless...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"When Captain Onion deploys, he ends up 
stealing the spotlight from Carrotman. 
That's a classic trope too!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Apparently it's pretty common. Let's 
make sure we don't accidentally steal the 
spotlight.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Then, Trainer! I'm gonna go back to turf 
sprints and polish my Carotene Power!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Where's our next big race?
choice_data_list:
Next up is the 『Takamatsunomiya Kinen』 
in a month.

Next up is the 『Takamatsunomiya Kinen』 
in a month, right?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"The Takamatsunomiya Kinen! A 1200m GⅠ, 
huh. Allllright!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
The power form I built up running on dirt 
will definitely pay off. I'll do my best 
in conditions I excel at!
choice_data_list:
Alright, next time I'll do my best for 
myself!

Yeah, do your best for your own sake next 
time!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the Takamatsunomiya Kinen, there were 
no Umamusume in particular who needed 
help.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus really only ought to run for 
her own sake, but...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian-san, um... could we get your 
thoughts on the race...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...I have nothing to say.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
I see... It was an unexpected finish out 
of the placings, but perhaps the injury 
really took a toll...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
—I lost because I was weak. The next race 
will be—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: The "Osaka Hai"... right?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: The Takamatsunomiya Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: Eeeeehhhhk!?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"The Takamatsunomiya Kinen!? What does 
that mean? Isn't her next race supposed to 
be the medium-distance Osaka Hai!?"

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian running in a sprint... If 
she's actually serious about this—

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
Hey, this is an extra! Call the desk! This 
is gonna cause one hell of an uproar.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—The Demon King strikes. An existence 
that never should have crossed paths with 
Biko Pegasus suddenly..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Coming to the Takamatsunomiya Kinen. 
Nobody knew what her true intention was.
